comments.author: @RobRagusa-g7k
comments.text:
For college students you need to go to a school that has internships or co-ops. It gets your foot in the door.  AI is the 90's version of offshoring. They thought that was the magic bullet and then we had a recession. 2001 to 2003 was impossible to get a job in tech out of school. Even seniors were difficult.  

The problem this time around. AI isn't fool proof and it doesn't understand nuance. I have experienced problems with different AI tools.  The truth is AI is like giving a nail gun to a carpenter. It doesn't replace the carpenter. It makes them more efficient because the carpenter still has the key knowledge and experience to adjust and use it properly.

Like the 1990's, we can get 3 or 4 programmers for the price of 1 senior in the US.  The disasters that followed companies realized what they could and couldn't offshore due to culture, language, skill set, etc.....
